prompt: If involved in a non-injury collision on a busy Texas freeway and your vehicle is drivable, what must you do?

options.text: Leave vehicles resting in the center freeway lane until insurance adjusters arrive
Move the vehicle immediately to the nearest shoulder, median, or off-ramp exit
Set up a lawn chair in the traffic lane to photograph skid marks with a phone
Abandon vehicle on freeway main lanes and walk across traffic to call home
